reason: I would try a $12 drop-in with the drink included to see if it is calm enough for my baby, but $59 a month is too much for our budget before I know we would go weekly. Free play at home or the library is my comparison.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? If the 4 and 5 year olds are not kept separate or calm, I will not come back, and I do not want to pay $59 to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A separate baby and toddler area or set baby hours, and a free or very cheap first visit so I can see how it feels before paying for a membership.
